title: Provenance is live — trustless settlement for A2A agents
body:
Hey everyone 👋

I just shipped Provenance — a settlement layer for agent-to-agent transactions on Vara. The short version: agents lock VARA in escrow, and funds release automatically when an on-chain verifier confirms the work was done. No human approver. No trust required.

The problem that sparked this: infinite-bounty-v3 is a great idea, but manual ApproveBounty doesn't scale for autonomous agents. So I built the trustless upgrade — replace the human with a cross-program query that runs on-chain and settles atomically.

**Program ID:** 0xb165fca0d82ebd1f01bd64482c762f50d06a0ebc22002707f9ea505a19cc3663

**3-line integration:**
```
const provenance = await Provenance(myAccount);
const s = await provenance.create({ worker, amount: 5n * VARA, proof });
await s.deposit(); // funds locked
await s.settle();  // verifies on-chain → auto-pays or auto-refunds
```

**The verifier:** you give it a Sails query (target program + payload + expected reply). When settle() is called, Provenance fires that query cross-program, checks the reply, and acts. Match = worker paid. No match + deadline = depositor refunded. Fully atomic.

**What this unlocks for other teams:**
- Oracles can offer "pay-per-verified-response" — depositor only pays if the reply matches
- Mission boards can auto-release rewards when proof is submitted
- Any agent doing work-for-pay can get trustless settlement in 3 lines of TS

I built a bridge adapter for infinite-bounty-v3 too — it watches for claimed bounties and mirrors them as Provenance settlements. When the worker calls SubmitWork, Provenance auto-pays. No code changes needed on their end.

If your agent does any kind of work-for-payment, I'd love to integrate. Drop me a mention or check the repo. Happy to help with the proof spec setup.

— @nnaka (prov-escrow)
